title: Crowdsource, Crawl, or Generate? Creating SEA-VL, a Multicultural Vision-Language Dataset for Southeast Asia

bias_targets.methodology: Human evaluation of AI-generated images and captions for Southeast Asian cultural concepts (e.g., local food, landmarks, traditions), scoring them on cultural correctness and naturalness using a 3-point Likert scale to assess the models' ability to capture regional nuances.

Human evaluation of vision-language models' ability to generate accurate and natural image captions in five underrepresented Southeast Asian languages (Thai, Malay, Tagalog, Indonesian, Vietnamese) compared to English.
